mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over 3 months signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, aggressive monetary tightening expectations cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, declining housing starts (HOUST) below 900 (thousands of units) signal weakening demand, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as policy responses are anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 900 and late-cycle expansion is active, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) year-over-year above 0.5% indicates strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS YoY growth > 0.5%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In demand contraction regime, housing starts (HOUST) below 900 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 435,000 million dollars cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to weakening consumer demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 900 and RSAFS < 435000, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to market expectations of aggressive monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
